result.reason: The clause appropriately replaces the no-hire with a mutual non-solicit, limits covered personnel to those directly involved in the services, and includes the required general-recruitment and unsolicited-approach carve-outs. However, the restriction runs for one year after the Agreement ends rather than for 12 months after each individual’s involvement ends, so it does not fully reach the fallback position and may apply materially longer than permitted. The phrase “is or was an employee” is also temporally imprecise.
